gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Authoritative and full of drive, College draws every curve as stout as its stems. Noto Sans Syriac takes the opposite job, with tall rounded bowls and wide, easy turns that make a sans feel friendly.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-syriac-e: College hits hard with one constant stroke width, big counters and tall lowercase all running at full volume. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern settles into a plain sans, its curve endings never crowding.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w:
College is a plain, unshaded line that never swells.

Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals well back from the stroke, so its small, tall-set sans letters feel dense and tidy under that blunt heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: College lays down a steady line with no pressure variation, and its big counters give headings real authority. Yet Noto Sans Tagalog is the one built for running text, its middle zone dominant and its curve gaps generous.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa keeps its curves open with clear gaps, and its lowercase fills most of the height, a modern sans. College can go larger.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: College draws its letters like spaghetti, one uniform line with big counters and a dynamic, authoritative pull. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet reads approachably, with short ascenders, a tall x-height and terminals pulled back from where each curve closes. Its strongest quality is the steady friction between College's wire-bent heft and that open plain sans.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads open, with a high-waisted lowercase. Shrink College and its heavy, unthinning curves lose their authority, while a large Noto Sans Takri would show off every generously unclosed round letter.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified, even at modest sizes. Its terminals stop far from the stem, so a long stretch of text feels open and modern beneath College's zero-contrast, dynamic strokes.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-tamil-su: Rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail is what defines College, giving it a dynamic, authoritative punch. But Noto Sans Tamil Supplement does the quieter work, its round forms like open parentheses and its tall middle band keeping a sans line stocky.
